title:
Validates all user inputs in the Unified Model Cloning Workflow.
Displays an error modal if the data is invalid.

Payload required fields:
- onSuccess: string - options are: "train" | "plot":
   - "plot": will plot the sensor preview chart if the data is valid
   - "train": will open the confirmation modal to start training if the data is valid
Other payload fields:
- bindings: payload for the the onSuccess action
name: ValidateModelCloningUserInputEpic
